column1: # Planted faults for the grid searches' record of failed grids (microqr-decoder.md, Lessons learned): the flag that the modules
# alone decided a grid's result, the record that packs and keeps such grids, and its use in the base grid and the scale and
# perspective searches. Also the error locator, whose updates now stop at the degree of the term they add and which fails once its
# length passes the block's capacity, in the correction every symbology runs.
# Against those classes (2026-10-29) 17 of the 20 are caught. Not caught: a skipped grid left uncharged, in either search, only lets a
# search go on past where its budget ended, and no test has a symbol that reads only there. A grid remembered after a re-read by
# coverage wrote over its modules is kept under the modules it sampled, so a later grid that samples those is skipped, with the read its
# own quiet zone or re-read could give. Outside those classes, UnevenLightingDecodeTest under this fault skipped such grids about
# 6,500 times and still read every symbol it asserts (a probe, 2026-10-29).
